sources.title: BAAI/AREX-2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Introduction AREX-2 is a 27B-parameter long-horizon agent model from the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI). It learns to improve a solution over multiple test-time rounds: propose, measure, reflect, and revise. sources.title: BAAI open-sources AREX-2, a 27B long-horizon… · AGI Hunt
sources.snippet: BAAI (Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence) has released AREX-2, a long-horizon agent model built on Qwen3.8 27B. It is open-sourced under Apache 2.0, supports 262K context, and learns from execution feedback to improve long-running task performance.
